headline: Ferry sold out. The next sailing still gets the car to Helsinki before the 27 Oct promise, if it is booked today.

facts.text: The overnight vehicle crossing (24 Oct 01:00 Helsinki time) is sold out.
The earlier booking attempt timed out. No reservation exists.
The 24 Oct 15:00 (Helsinki time) sailing has a vehicle slot for €387. Quoted, not booked.
The driver can take the later sailing if the overnight stop and return travel are arranged.
The dealer wants to approve any later delivery date before it is promised. This plan keeps the 27 Oct date.
The 24 Oct sailing arrives 25 Oct 18:00 Helsinki time, two days before the 27 Oct 13:00–15:00 promise.

proposals.title: Book the 24 Oct 15:00 sailing and one hotel night near the terminal (€490)
proposals.rationale: It is the first sailing with a vehicle slot, and it still arrives before the 27 Oct promise. The driver agreed if the overnight stop is arranged. Check first that the failed attempt left no booking.

draftMessage.body: The overnight ferry for CD-420299 was sold out, so the car moves to the 24 Oct sailing. Delivery stays as promised: 27 Oct 13:00–15:00.

proposals.whatHappensNext: On approval the agent checks the earlier failed attempt left no booking, books the sailing and hotel, tells the driver, and sends the dealer this short update.
proposals.whatHappensAfter: The agent is booking the sailing and hotel and telling the driver. The dealer gets the update that delivery stays on 27 Oct.

steps.summary: The 07:10 booking attempt has no reference at the ferry line. Nothing was booked or charged.
24 Oct 01:00 sold out. 24 Oct 15:00 has a vehicle slot for €387 (quote, not booked). Times in Helsinki time.
The driver already wrote at 08:05 that the later sailing works if the overnight stop and return travel are arranged. The dealer wants to approve any later date first.

steps.text: The next sailing still arrives on 25 Oct, before the 27 Oct promise, so the date holds. But booking costs €490, so a person has to say yes.

steps.summary: Waiting for a yes on the booking (€490). The delivery date stays the same.

timeline.text: I have the gig for CD-420299, but I do not have a ferry reference. Is the overnight vehicle crossing booked?
The overnight sailing returned sold out. The later sailing has a quote only. Check driver rest and customer promise before purchase.
Please keep us informed. We need to approve a later delivery date before it is promised to the receiving contact.
